expansion”是较低密度材料所关联的热膨胀。一个是掺杂导致的晶格变化，另一个是热膨胀现象，语境中的诱因与物理指代不同。","left_evidence":{"mention_id":"iTE:P1456:n3","quote_span":"The lattice parameters are found to increase with increasing Bi efficiency”，支持这里的泛化短语在该语境下指同一类热转电效率。","left_evidence":{"mention_id":"TG:P0302:n2","quote_span":"assess the route to achieve a high heat-to-electricity conversion 指热驱动的扩散过程。两者都涉及扩散，但左侧语境没有说明由温度梯度驱动，不能判同义或据此认定上下位。","left_evidence":{"mention_id":"iTE:P1429:n2","quote_span":"enhancing diffusion not only of In+ but also other
